eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CIVIL EMERGENCY MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Owyhee, ID; at 6:54 PM on AUG 8, 2026 Effective until 8:54 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Owyhee County has issued a civil emergency Level 3 Go Now Alert. From Big Springs Road & Battle Creek Road to the North East to Wickahoney South to the Nevada border East to Hwy 51 to include Riddle Ranch.Contact Owyhee County at 208-495-1205 for additional information.This message was sent by the Idaho State Communications Center and is now concluded.
